metadata.description: Book 15, Chapter 12, task 7: forward the identity servers' Windows event logs to the Log Analytics workspace through Azure Monitor Agent, instead of a scheduled script writing to an administrative share. One data collection rule (Windows events to the Event table) and an association for each Azure Arc-enabled server. A person deploys it after review (what-if first); the scheduled identity only reads. Illustrative: not deployed to a live subscription.
The Log Analytics workspace (Sentinel's, where security operations reviews the logs)
The Azure Arc-enabled servers in this resource group, such as the directory synchronization servers
